# anthropic_users (Data Source)

Lists organization members. Works with any admin or enterprise credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_users" "developers" {
  roles = ["developer", "claude_code_user"]
}

output "developer_emails" {
  value = data.anthropic_users.developers.users[*].email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Filter by email address.
- `roles` (List of String) Filter by organization roles (any match).

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (String) Timestamp the member joined.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `id` (String) User id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `role` (String) Organization role.
